lessons.claim: ★ Flow raises the pair distribution in the compressional quadrant and lowers it in the extensional one -- g = g_eq[1 + Pe*g1], g1 = -(e_r.Ehat.e_r) f(r) with f>0 and monotonically decreasing (Batchelor 1977). A sign prediction directly measurable with 2D BD, and a kind of verification we do not have (the flow distortion of a spatial correlation). But Pe->inf (non-Brownian) simple shear is a singular limit where g is undetermined because of the closed orbits, so 'raise Pe and look at the limit' does not work
